$$M_j(x) = \sum_{r=0}^{\min(j,n)} S(j,r)\,(n-x)^{\underline{r}}\binom{2n-r}{n-r}.$$

On the other hand, $\binom{-1}{m} = (-1)^m$, so

Setting $j = n-m$ and $N = 2n+1$:
